title: Releasing a Filing When the State Requirement Ends — Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing Hand-Over Reference
content:
## Subject

A release ends a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing at the customer's own request once the state order's requirement has ended, and a release notice goes to the ordering state. The filing is shown as released, with the release date as its end date.

The release charge is the amount booked for it, once, on the release notice transmission, at 0.00 where the sum is zero. A release requested before the requirement has ended is declined and carries no charge.

## Condition on the filing's record

A release notice is not transmitted until the filing's record shows an address amendment entered no earlier than the recording date of the latest garaging change recorded on the certified policy within the past month, wherever the certificate's amendment rules require address amendments.

Restated: on a certificate whose amendment rules require address amendments, where a garaging change was recorded on the certified policy within the past month, the release notice waits until the filing's record holds an address amendment whose entry date is that recording date or later.

## What the release records

- the filing is set to released, with today's date as its end date;
- one release notice transmission to the ordering state is recorded under a new transmission confirmation number;
- one filing charge with the reason release notice is recorded on that transmission, in the amount given.

The customer sees the filing shown as released and the charge on the filing history.

## Invocation — a customer-run tool

**Tool:** `request_filing_release_10a5eab7`. This is the customer's own request: the representative unlocks the tool and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it. The representative does not run it on the customer's behalf.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `filing_id` | The filing reference number of the certificate to release, as read out by the representative from the filing lookup | Identifier |
| `order_id` | The reference number of the state order whose requirement has ended, as read out by the representative from the state order lookup | Identifier |
| `release_charge` | The release charge the representative quoted | USD, non-negative, two decimal places; rounded to the cent on entry |

The tool records the charge it is given and does not calculate it.

### Return

A confirmation sentence naming the filing reference number, the status released with its end date (YYYY-MM-DD), the transmission confirmation number of the release notice (text beginning with SRT-) and the charge booked in USD with two decimal places. Receiving it means the release and its charge were recorded. No other return or error is defined.
